paths.description: List of directories or files to scan. If empty, lr defaults to the current directory.

sort_order.description: Sort order string using single letters defined in lr(1) SORT ORDER (e.g., 'n' for name, 's' for size, 'a' for atime).

format_string.description: Custom format string for output. See lr(1) FORMATTING. If empty, default listing is used.

regex.description: POSIX ERE regex to match filenames against (lr -e).

test.description: Complex test expression to filter files (lr -t). See lr(1) TESTS.

traverse_subdirs.description: Whether to enter and list subdirectories.

human_readable_size.description: Whether to print file sizes in human-readable format (-h).
